questions.stem: The LONGEST river in the world is:
questions.explanation: Nile — about 6,650 km (though some recent measurements rank Amazon as slightly longer at ~7,000 km; most authorities still place Nile first by the traditional measurement). Flows from East Africa through Sudan and Egypt into the Mediterranean.
questions.subject: Geography
questions.topic: Rivers of the world — mixed tiers

questions.stem: The LARGEST river by water discharge (volume) is:
questions.explanation: Amazon discharges ~209,000 m³/s into the Atlantic — more than the next seven largest rivers combined. Drains ~6.9 million km² (>40% of South America). Congo is second (~41,000 m³/s).

questions.stem: Match the CAPITAL with the RIVER it stands on. A. Paris.  B. London.  C. Cairo.  D. Baghdad. List-II: 1. Seine.  2. Thames.  3. Nile.  4. Tigris.
questions.explanation: Paris — Seine. London — Thames. Cairo — Nile. Baghdad — Tigris. (Further useful: Rome — Tiber; Vienna — Danube; Berlin — Spree; Moscow — Moskva; Washington D.C. — Potomac; Budapest — Danube; Dhaka — Buriganga.)

questions.stem: The HWANG HO (Yellow River) of China gets its name from:

options.option_text: Colour of the rocks at its source
Golden river dolphins that live in it

questions.explanation: Hwang Ho flows through the yellow loess plateau of north China; it carries vast quantities of fine yellow silt — up to 1.6 billion tonnes per year historically — giving the water its characteristic yellow-brown colour. Also called 'China's Sorrow' due to disastrous floods.

questions.stem: Consider the following about the RIVER DANUBE. 1. It is the second-longest river in Europe (after the Volga). 2. It flows through 10 countries — more than any other river in the world. 3. It drains into the Black Sea via a delta in Romania and Ukraine. 4. Four national capitals sit on its banks: Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest, Belgrade. Which are correct?
questions.explanation: All four correct. Danube: source in Germany's Black Forest, length ~2,850 km, traverses Germany, Austria, Slovakia, Hungary, Croatia, Serbia, Bulgaria, Romania, Moldova, Ukraine — 10 countries. More national capitals on its banks than any other river.

questions.stem: The MURRAY-DARLING river system is in:
questions.explanation: Murray-Darling is Australia's longest river system (~3,750 km) and its most important agricultural basin (eastern/south-eastern Australia). Empties into Southern Ocean via Lake Alexandrina in South Australia.

questions.stem: Which river forms a NATURAL BOUNDARY between the United States and Mexico?
questions.explanation: Rio Grande forms ~2,000 km of the US-Mexico border — from El Paso, Texas to the Gulf of Mexico. Known as Río Bravo on the Mexican side. Source: southern Colorado mountains.
